top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the theoretical discovery of the Z2 topological insulator and quantum spin Hall state (Kane and Mele, a joint pair of papers) with its first decisive experimental observation in HgTe quantum wells (Molenkamp). The theory-plus-first-realisation split is compact and defensible, the interpretation has held up for almost two decades under transport, photoemission and scanning-probe tests, and the idea reaches well beyond one subfield. The 2016 overlap is answerable because Z2 insulators rest on time-reversal symmetry and spin-orbit coupling. The cost is the omission of Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and of the 3D work, so the citation must stay narrow. P002 (optical lattice clocks) is mature and cleanly attributed, but I rank it second because it is narrower in reach and I discount my own atomic-physics proximity. An award is better than none, so P000 is last.
recusal_note: No documented collaboration with Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye. Field proximity to the atomic-physics proposal P002 is disclosed. Ursula Keller's ETH group, with which I have collaborated, shares an institution with Andreas Wallraff (B038), who is not on the slate. None of this requires recusal on the profile alone.
